findings.title: The Find anything box on Home showed no focus
findings.plain: Someone using a keyboard could not see when the Find anything box on Home had focus, so typing seemed to go nowhere.
findings.fix: Give the field its own 2px accent outline when focused (form.ask input:focus-visible).
findings.manual_step: Press Tab until the Find anything box on Home is reached: a clear orange ring must show around it.
findings.reverify_note: not machine-verifiable: found by reading or on a device — no script can confirm the fix
findings.verification: render-check.mjs: focus-not-visible for "Find anything" no longer reported on /hub (re-run 2026-10-23)

findings.title: Appearance switches were 40x22 and crowded
findings.plain: The High contrast and Reduce motion switches in the Aa menu were under 24 px tall and close together, so a shaky hand or finger could hit the wrong one.
findings.fix: Extend each switch link 4 px beyond the drawn pill (inset:-4px).
findings.manual_step: Open the Aa menu on a phone and tap High contrast, then Reduce motion: each tap changes only the switch you meant.
findings.reverify_note: not machine-verifiable: found by reading or on a device — no script can confirm the fix
findings.verification: render-check.mjs: target-size for "contrast on" no longer reported on /hub/talk (re-run 2026-10-23)
